elements.text: When you think about pickles, you probably imagine the long green ones that come in a jar. These are the most common pickles, the pickled cucumber. But there are many other pickles in the world. In fact, all kinds of food can be pickled. They just need to be mixed with a salty sauce or vinegar and placed in a jar.

In Russia, many people pickle tomatoes, and in Poland people pickle fish. In the Middle East, meals often come with pickled lemons or peppers. Even sweet fruits can be pickled. For example, some cooks pickle strawberries and cherries.

Pickling started as a way to make foods last longer. Pickled foods could be stored and eaten in winter when fruits and vegetables were not available. They could also be taken on long journeys. Today, people still sometimes pickle food to save it. But they also pickle food just for the satisfying sour taste.

elements.text: The meat-and-rice dish called jambalaya is famous in America. No one knows for sure where it came from, though. One common story is that jambalaya started when Spanish people came to Louisiana hundreds of years ago. In Europe, the Spanish had a rice and fish dish made with saffron, a special seasoning. Saffron was hard to get in Louisiana, though. So, the Spanish had to make their dish a different way.

The Spanish used rice and seasonings brought to Louisiana by people from West Africa. They also used tomatoes and hot red pepper, which were first grown by Native Americans. Other groups of people in Louisiana added new ingredients to the dish as well. French people added onions, bell peppers, and celery. Creole cooks added their own special seasonings to the dish. And Cajuns took out the tomatoes and added sausages instead. All these changes helped shape jambalaya into the delicious dish it is today.

elements.text: The scary-looking needles of the prickly pear cactus discourage many people and animals from getting too close. But if you look past the sharp points, you'll find that there's a lot more to this cactus. Native Americans in the southwestern United States made gum, candy, jelly, and juice with the fruit. They also used the cactus's leaves, known as pads, to treat cuts and burns.

But how do you eat this cactus? After taking out the needles, you can eat the flat green pads raw or cooked. Many people enjoy this cactus in salads and tacos. You can also eat the prickly pear's bright red or orange fruits, called tunas. Some say that the fruit tastes like a mix of bubble gum and watermelon. Taste it yourself to see if you agree!
